hooks.name: Secrets Check on Save
hooks.description: Warns when a committed file may contain raw secrets, API keys, or real CNIC/NTN values. Non-blocking — outputs a warning only.

action.command: node -e "const f=require('fs');const p=process.argv[1];const c=f.readFileSync(p,'utf8');const secrets=['sk-','AKIA','password','secret','cnic','ntn'];const hits=[];secrets.forEach(s=>{if(c.toLowerCase().includes(s.toLowerCase())&&!p.includes('.example')&&!p.includes('.md')){hits.push(s);}});if(hits.length){console.error('WARNING: Possible sensitive value in '+p+': '+hits.join(', '));}" "$KIRO_FILE" 2>&1
